Answer: B
Reason: The ultrasound images demonstrate a multicystic mass in the fetal thorax with significant vascular supply (confirmed by color Doppler), characteristic of a hybrid lung lesion or CPAM. Such lesions typically arise in the middle or lower lobes and, due to their mass effect, commonly displace the mediastinum/heart to the contralateral side and elevate the ipsilateral hemidiaphragm, matching the description in option B.
